must_fix: (criteria 5, 4) SNA, the largest holding (10.0%, one of 9 full-conviction names = 59% of weight), has a reverse DCF at WACC 8.0% (dossiers/SNA.md section 7), below the programme basis (10-year Treasury 5.17% + ERP, WACC about 9.2%, the basis DVH1 itself verified for ACN). I reproduced the dossier's 2.9% implied growth at 8.0% and get about 5.6% at 9.2% on the same FY25 FCF base ($0.982bn) against the dossier's own 5-7% base case: in_line, not below (3.0% only if the 53-week-distorted H1'26-annualised FCF of $1.19bn is used). DVH1 scored this MINOR and wrote 'direction unchanged and stronger', which is the wrong direction. Fix: re-run SNA's reverse DCF on the programme basis with the FCF base chosen and justified, restate implied_vs_base, and if in_line downgrade to INCLUDE-SMALL (5% cap) and rebuild. Then re-test every full-conviction holding (BR, CAH, COR, GDDY, ACGL, WFC, WTW, V) with the same WACC-tie check. Verify: a table of WACC used vs 5.17% + ERP for all 20 holdings.

(criteria 1, 5) Build, report and register disagree on UDR (5.0%, the half-conviction cap). code/lead_build_portfolio.py lines about 190-195 take 'implied' for top-70 names from V1/V2R ('attractive' maps to below), ignoring the RA14 re-assessment that moved UDR below -> in_line (outputs/lead_verdict_changes.json; all500_register.json says in_line; the build candidates say below). Rule (j) ranks 'below' ahead of 'in_line', so UDR is probably held only because the re-assessment was not propagated. Same mismatch for eligible DLTR (build in_line, register below), DRI and EOG (build below, register in_line). Fix: let the dossier/F-summary implied_vs_base (IMPLIED_NORM) override the V1 mapping, rebuild, and assert build implied == register implied for every eligible name (currently 4 mismatches).

(criteria 3, 9) FINAL_REPORT.md does not meet the Loop-11 disclosure requirements and its verification registers are stale. (a) Rule (o) and the technology share are not stated anywhere (grep for '(o)', 'technology', 'IT-only' finds nothing): computed from lead_portfolio_build.json it is 26.19% including Visa (Payments) and 19.34% IT-only, i.e. IT-only is below the 20% floor and the rule is met only through Visa; the build's 'tech_rule_o' does not record the achieved figure. (b) Appendix A.5 prints 'not yet checked' for ACN, SNA, BIIB, ACGL, ADSK, WFC, FSLR, INTU, WTW and V although DVH1/DVH2/DVH4/DV02 independently checked all of them (lead_report_appendix.py does not read the DV series; A.4 omits the DV/DVH/RA series and its C1 row still names the 27 Sep build). (c) Nowhere does the report say that only about 70 of the 446 dossiers without an earlier check are independently verified, while sections 1 and 6 say all 500 were 'researched in full'. In the DV02/DV09 samples (20 names) 11 names had at least one FAIL and 3 verdicts changed, so the unverified bench (224 eligible names) should carry that caveat. Fix: print the tech figure (both) in sections 1 and 6, make A.4/A.5 read dv/*.json and list the RA/DV series, and add a one-line verification-coverage statement with the sample FAIL rate.

(criteria 6, 3) The risk headline rests on one calm window. Section 7 and A.3 give beta 0.56, 38% market share of risk, tracking error 12.8% and 17 independent bets from 2023-09-25..2026-09-25 only. I recomputed the same sleeve over 2005-2026 (missing prices renormalised): beta 0.93 (2005-09), 0.98 (2010-14), 0.97 (2015-19), 0.97 (2020-23), 0.56 only in the latest three years; full-history volatility 19.2% (S&P 18.9%), TE 8.4%. The report's own stress replays agree with beta near 1: COVID -34.4% vs S&P -33.7%, Q4 2018 -20.4% vs -19.3%, 2011 -19.0% vs -18.4%. A reader told 'beta 0.56' would expect to lose about half the market's fall. Fix: report beta/vol/TE by sub-period and full history, state that 0.56 is a recent-window figure, use stress-period beta in the narrative, and give the 10-points-a-year odds at both TE values (22%/4% at 12.8%; lower at 8.4%).

(criterion 3) The rule-(j) order-dependence statistic is nearly tautological and the over-time comparison is not like-for-like. 9 of the 12 'names chosen under every ordering' (ACGL BR CAH COR GDDY SNA V WFC WTW) are simply the only 9 INCLUDE names, and every ordering ranks conviction first or ties; of the 11 half-conviction slots (40.7% of weight) only CVS, DG and DVA are invariant, chosen from 140 tied 'below' candidates by a scenario-return tie-breaker. Orderings 1 and 3 are identical (overlap 20), so there are 3 distinct alternatives, not 4. Fix: report invariance within the half-conviction group separately, drop or caveat the 12->6->12 history, and say that about 41% of the portfolio weight is an order-dependent pick from a tied pool.

(criterion 10, ninth consecutive loop) code/lead_verify_gate.py is OPEN again for the single reason that C1 names an older build (current content_sha256 45758e6055db); the Loop-10 request to run rebuild -> C1 -> freeze -> audit once with nothing in between was not done. The RA/DV re-assessments are agent edits whose verdict changes were appended by hand to lead_verdict_changes.json and are not in run_all.py, and the new quarter-label control (lead_quarter_label_check.py) skips non-December fiscal years: 9 of the 20 holdings (DG ACN SYF CAH ADSK BR INTU COR V; 43.5% of weight) are 'not checkable' although non-December year-ends are where the TJX/PTC-type mislabels arose. Fix: map fiscal quarters through XBRL fiscal-period fields (fy/fp) so all holdings are checkable; run C1 as the final step on the frozen build and show PASS; script the RA/DV verdict-change append.
